title: Cyclotron-web: restore isBasedOn in article JSON-LD
description: Live articles carried isBasedOn (the Anth.us original) in JSON-LD; core Article JSON-LD omits it. Add via a core seo option or head hook.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in Papyrus PR #464 (b1f1467), released in 5.10.0+, deployed fleet-wide on 5.12.0. 7954f8: redirects use the projector's public path. 9cd419: placeholder escape, empty leading column fix, site.dateFormat/ledeField, groupBy field:<name>, seo.articleTypes. 2c3c69: seo.isBasedOnField, live on cyclotron.anth.us articles (JSON-LD isBasedOn). Docs in docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md.
